title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica Film Opens in Taiwan on Same Day as Japan on October 16
content: Taiwanese anime distributor Bahamut Animation Crazy announced on Monday that Muse Asia will open the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film in Taiwan on October 16, the same day it opens in Japan. The film is a sequel to both BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica . The BanG Dream!
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses Toaru Anbu no Item Anime
content: Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the television anime of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item (A Certain ITEM of the Dark Side) spinoff novel. The anime will begin streaming in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 9.
author: ANN

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax! Anime Streams in India
content: The second season of the anime began streaming on the channel on September 10. The first season began streaming on September 4. Kei Oikawa ( Hinamatsuri , Outbreak Company ) returned from the second season to direct the third season at studio feel.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World' Season 3, Suikoden: The Anime,
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Sunday that it has licensed the third season of the As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World television anime , with the first episode already available.
author: ANN

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers, The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
content: Aniplus Asia announced on Friday and Monday that it will air simulcasts for the Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers anime and The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me anime for the fall 2026 anime season.
author: ANN

title: 4th Batch of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English Dubs of Naruto Shippūden Anime Stream on Crunchyroll
content: Crunchyroll released the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the anime on July 6 with plans to roll out additional batches of dubbed episodes through September 2026. It began streaming the dubs of episodes 113-175 on August 17 and the dubs of episodes 176-196 on September 7.
author: ANN

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Opens in Singapore, Malaysia at #1
content: Cinema Online Singapore reported on Friday that Sony Pictures Entertainment 's live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise has opened at #1 in both the Singaporean and Malaysian box office. The film opened in Singapore on September 17, and in Malaysia on September 16.
author: ANN

title: Anime Festival Asia Singapore 2026 Takes Place on November 27-29
content: Sozo Pte. Ltd. , the organizer of the Anime Festival Asia conventions, announced last Saturday that Anime Festival Asia Singapore will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.
author: ANN

title: Kodansha India Announces 5 Manga Titles Including Attack on Titan, Witch Hat Atelier, More
content: Kodansha 's English X (formerly Twitter ) account announced on Monday the first five manga titles Kodansha India will launch. The company launched an official Instagram account .
author: ANN
